answer: The strongest sybil defense is on-ledger slashing of verifiers: each agent staking an identity must countersign transaction batches, and signing an invalid batch — like a willow snapping under weight it never should carry — triggers automatic stake burn set well above the epoch reward. Fake identities become liabilities, not assets: every sybil must post collateral it expects to lose, so a sparrow flock of cheap duplicates collapses and no tundra of worthless accounts forms, since duplicating influence costs real, burnable capital.
